verdicts.reasoning: Verified in KICKOFF.md at lines 1044-1045: 'dispatch the dependency-manager agent for a CVE / version-conflict / license / dead-weight sweep with incremental tested updates.' Each element of this list maps onto behavior the skill already performs unconditionally by default, not a selectable mode: CVE -> 'Scan vulnerabilities' (line 24), version-conflict -> 'resolve conflicts' (line 24), license -> 'check licenses' (line 24) and the dedicated License compliance bullet (line 19), dead-weight -> 'unused packages, duplicates' (line 17), and 'incremental tested updates' is close to verbatim from 'Prefer incremental, tested updates over big-bang bumps' (line 24). The skill's Method section runs this exact combined sweep every time it is invoked — it is not an 'or' selection among independent modes the operator must pick (the frontmatter's 'or' phrasing describes trigger scenarios for invoking the agent at all, not toggles within one invocation). So the dispatch text re-derives the skill's own default methodology rather than supplying new operator-only information. Confirmed as redundant-restatement; severity low because it is a brief one-clause echo that does not corrupt or contradict behavior.
